answer: Proposed weekly gate: survey-agent IDs label shale, onyx and meadow images and lock 100 tokens each for the full week. Validators check exclusive escrow and audit sampled outputs against hidden expert labels before granting one vote. Missing outputs or failed audits mean no vote and a 10-token slash; remaining stake returns at week end. Hardware sharing and parallelism do not lower that lock. Bad reference labels or collusion defeat audits; wealth still buys IDs. Ten IDs lock 1,000 tokens; if borrowed at an assumed 1% weekly rate, financing alone costs 10 tokens/week.
